products.description:
3DZ PLA Silver Grey Filaments 1.75mm

Description:

PLA 3D printing material is made of fully bio-degradable material with high purity and international standard quality PLA to set new benchmarks in the filament. PLA 3D printing full form is Polylactic acid or polylactide which is made up of plant cellulose starches like sugar cane or beets to sequester transforming it into the long-chain formation of sugar or beets molecules. The chain formation of starches molecules is converted into a polymer and has a plastic-like feel.
